radiology_report:
LUMC (Leiden)
Imaging Department
Date: 28 Dec 2024
Exam: mpMRI prostate

Clinical indication: PSA 7.4 ng/mL (rising trend from 2.0 in Aug 2022 to 3.8 in Nov 2023). Prior negative biopsy. Evaluate for suspicious lesion.

FINDINGS:
Prostate volume is 28.0 mL. T2-weighted imaging demonstrates a focal, ill-defined hypointense lesion in the peripheral zone of the left base, measuring approximately 12 mm in maximum diameter. On diffusion-weighted imaging, this lesion shows marked restricted diffusion (low ADC values). Dynamic contrast-enhanced sequences demonstrate early and intense enhancement of the same area, correlating with the DWI/T2 findings. No extracapsular extension or seminal vesicle involvement is identified. No suspicious lymphadenopathy or osseous lesions.

IMPRESSION:
- PI-RADS 5 lesion in the left peripheral zone base.
- Prostate volume: 28.0 mL; PSA density: 0.25 ng/mL/mL.
- Clinical T stage: cT1c.
- csPCa predicted probability 0.7299785.

previous_notes.author: Dr. P. van Dijk (GP)
previous_notes.text: Patient presented with a PSA of 3.8 ng/mL, noted to be rising from a baseline of 2.0 ng/mL measured in August 2022. Digital rectal examination was unremarkable. Given the PSA velocity and persistent elevation, a systematic prostate biopsy was scheduled and subsequently performed. The patient was advised to follow up with the urology department for result discussion and further management planning.

pathology_report:
Biopsy 1 (17 May 2024): Systematic template biopsy was performed. Histological examination of all submitted cores reveals benign prostatic tissue with benign glandular hyperplasia and chronic inflammation. No prostatic adenocarcinoma is identified. Gleason score 0+0, ISUP grade group 0. No cribriform or intraductal patterns identified. No perineural invasion is seen.

Biopsy 2 (10 Jan 2025): Targeted and systematic template biopsy was performed following mpMRI. Histological examination shows benign prostatic tissue without evidence of malignancy. Gleason score 0+0, ISUP grade group 0. No cribriform or intraductal patterns identified. No perineural invasion is seen.

Summary: The patient has undergone two separate biopsy procedures. Both timepoints report a Gleason score of 0+0 and ISUP grade group 0, with no high-risk architectural patterns or perineural invasion noted. The trajectory across timepoints is stable in terms of reported histological grade.

AI-predicted ISUP grade group (digital pathology): grade group 5.
